user-service.role: Owns user accounts, persists them to PostgreSQL, publishes a user-created event to Kafka, and calls notification-service through the API gateway.

notification-service.role: Consumes the user-created Kafka topic and serves POST /v1/send (behind the /api/notifications gateway prefix) for ad-hoc notification sends.

audit-service.role: Go service that consumes the user-created topic, writes an entry to the audit_log PostgreSQL table, and serves POST /v1/audit.

gateway.role: Express API gateway that proxies /api/users/*, /api/notifications/*, and /api/audit/* to the three backend services.
